create_plot_accessor: create a PlotAccessor to generate line, bar, hist, box, kde, area, pie, scatter, or hexbin plots from pandas Series or DataFrame
build_hist_series: build a histogram plot from a pandas Series with configurable bins, grid, and legend options
build_boxplot: build a box-and-whisker plot from DataFrame columns optionally grouped by a categorical column
create_kde_plot: create a kernel density estimate plot from pandas data with configurable bandwidth method and evaluation points
run_scatter_plot: run a scatter plot from DataFrame columns with configurable marker size and color mapping
